app.name: Building Portal
app.credit: Made by Mohammed AbuHassan for the Taqat AI Coding sessions

landing.heroTitle: Building maintenance, handled in one place
landing.heroSubtitle: Report an issue in your apartment, follow its progress, and stay up to date with building news and fees — from any device, in English or Arabic.
landing.inviteNote: Access is by invitation. Ask the building administration if you have not received your invite.
landing.featuresSubtitle: A simple portal that keeps residents and management on the same page.

requests.title: Maintenance requests
requests.desc: Describe the problem, add photos, set the urgency, and submit in under a minute.

tracking.title: Live status tracking
tracking.desc: Follow every request from new to done, and chat with management right on the request.

announcements.title: Building announcements
announcements.desc: Never miss a water cut-off, elevator service, or meeting — notices reach every resident.

fees.title: Fees at a glance
fees.desc: See what is due, what has been paid, and when — no more chasing paper receipts.

admin.title: Management dashboard
admin.desc: Administrators triage requests, manage apartments and residents, and keep private notes.

bilingual.title: English & Arabic
bilingual.desc: Fully bilingual with right-to-left layout, so every resident feels at home.

one.title: Get invited
one.desc: The building administration sends you an invitation email and links you to your apartment.

two.title: Report an issue
two.desc: Sign in, describe the problem, attach photos, and pick how urgent it is.

three.title: Track it to done
three.desc: Watch the status change, exchange comments, and get notified when it is resolved.

landing.ctaSubtitle: Sign in with the email you were invited with.
